inherited_nominal_evidence.reason: Policy tensor state evolves during deterministic execution. Requiring initial digest to equal final digest was an audit error: each first-attempt nominal arm's initial digest, final digest and full-step physics hash exactly match its corresponding retained fixed14s historical arm. No optimizer or checkpoint writes occurred.

fixed.other_nodes: Original 2s authority mask and frozen controller; no action outside node 1

protocol.historical_equivalence: New nominal four-arm scientific records, full-step physics streams and first-Walk predecision state must match retained fixed14s evidence before any novel state is run. On mismatch stop and retain all observations.
protocol.observability_diagnostic: Compare only nine frozen allowlisted predecision observables, excluding context and case ID; record raw differences versus nominal and between novel states. A route XY difference >=0.01m or route/reference heading difference >=1deg is a descriptive diagnostic, not a success threshold and never changes membership.
protocol.outcome_contract: Unchanged experiments/phase3b/decision_oracle_001/contract.json and oracle.py. Nominal, physical, all-node strict, own-reference final world endpoint norm and absolute commanded-axis lateral/heading determine eligibility. No least-bad choice.
protocol.purpose: Acquire a small complete same-state four-mode outcome matrix for the existing fixed14s Oracle; no recovery optimization or Jev call
protocol.readiness: At least one exact confirmed unique admissible recovery plus CONTINUE and ABSTAIN types and observable distinction is required for GO_FOR_JEV_OFFLINE_SHADOW. Otherwise RECOVERY_VOCABULARY_NOT_READY; no Jev invocation.
protocol.run_matrix: Exactly four ordered primary arms per declared state, nominal execution-equivalence control first; conditional exact four-arm repeat only for the first state with a unique admissible recovery under the frozen Oracle
protocol.state_binding: For each arm compare exact predecessor Stand scientific output, full qpos/qvel/ctrl at predecision, planned origin/heading, selected reference and policy tensor hash. A state is not labelable unless all four complete, same-state outcomes are retained.
protocol.state_construction: Only case ID and Stand duration differ for Stand5; only case ID and declared +Y push during Stand differ for Push60. Push must end before Walk entry. No perturbation or state injection after decision.
protocol.stop_rule: Stop before novel states on nominal equivalence failure. Execute full ordered four-arm matrix for each physically reached novel predecision state; retain every negative or censored cell. No infrastructure retry. If predecessor Stand fails before decision, record construction failure and do not fabricate a label. After all primaries, repeat exactly the first unique admissible recovery state across all four modes once; otherwise no repeat. Never add states or change action/window/amplitude.

provenance.inherited_source_chain: YAW.verify_inputs and verify_freeze traversed before physics; checkpoint, robot, simulation, controller and evaluator pins
